in_hebrew.name: Prudy
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Prudy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the English word ‘prudent’, meaning wise, sensible, and discerning. However, the name Prudy has come to be associated with modesty, virtue, and simplicity. In the Middle Ages, prudence was considered one of the seven heavenly virtues.
